newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end ahead, AMS leads way.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end ahead, AMS leads way.

text.p: Austrian shares finished a session of narrow range-trading slightly firmer on Friday.
Traders said investor interest was meagre with the market at current levels and are cautiously optimistic for next week.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips gained 4.46 points, or 0.38 percent, to 1,174.62 with 12 shares higher, seven lower, and two unchanged by the close.
Traders said the market was subdued, with many waiting for the release of U.S. fourth quarter GDP.
"We'll see where we're headed on Monday," said one.
Basic market sentiment is positive, said another but "we've often failed to get through 1,180 points."
A further rise in the ATX is ruled out as long as the ATX heavyweights continued to consolidate.
The day's best performer was microchip producer AMS, up 4.52 percent at 995, while the worst was Vienna airport operator Flughafen, down 3.84 percent at 551.
Traders said AMS was in demand after a rise in the U.S. semiconductor index.
The all-share Vienna bourse index added on 1.01 points, or 0.23 percent, to 439.17.
The February ATX future fell 0.2 points to 1,175.8 on turnover of 659 contracts.
